name: List All Portfolios
description: Returns all portfolios that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter portfolios by unique identifier. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter portfolios updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Default
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the portfolio is the default portfolio

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyIds
responseFields.description: Unique identifier(s) of the properties associated with the portfolio. Note: The portfolio endpoint returns hidden properties. To associate hidden properties yielded from this endpoint with those from the Properties endpoint, ensure the IncludeHidden filter is enabled.

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the portfolio's details were last updated

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
